name: api-client
title: API client
description: Envelope-aware axios instance with bearer-token auth in memory (no localStorage), httpOnly refresh-cookie rotation, cold-start session bootstrap, cross-tab Web Lock single-flight 401 retry, proactive token refresh, and UI-agnostic onError/onSessionExpired hooks.
postInstall: Call bootstrapSession() from your entry route before deciding signed-in vs. login (fewbie ADR-001 / devbie ADR-040). Adjust BASE_URL / legacy storage keys / REFRESH_PATH / REFRESH_LOCK_NAME in src/lib/api-client.ts to match your backend contract.
